chunks: That we may sing Your praises much,

key_terms.نُسَبِّحَ: We glorify (specifically using the phrase SubhanAllah)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to glorify God frequently in Islamic supplication?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this phrase reflects the believer's plea for divine assistance to maintain constant remembrance amidst worldly distractions, a concept central to Shia spiritual psychology. Scholars highlight that 'kathiran' (frequently) implies not just quantity but the quality of presence in dhikr, aligning with the Imams' teachings on purifying the heart through consistent glorification.
